card.name: Words just before 'active' metabolite or ingredient
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the', 'its' or 'same', and 'active' itself, right before the word 'active' (or a related term such as prodrug) in a parenthetical about a drug's active metabolite, moiety or ingredient.

modes.label: 'the' in a parenthetical
modes.description: The word 'the' opens a bracketed aside naming a drug's active metabolite, moiety or prodrug.

modes.label: 'its' or 'same' before active
modes.description: A linking word such as 'same' or 'its' comes right before 'active ingredient' or 'active metabolite'.
modes.example: a higher dose of the<< same>> active ingredient (lamivudine)

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word 'active' next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that something is the active form or active part of a drug.
